title: ForesightSafety-SAGE:A Fully Automated Scenario Generation and Safety Evaluation Framework for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2606.08531v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly evolving from simple text-based interaction systems into LLM agents that can maintain memory, use tools, access external environments, and execute tasks. As their capabilities and autonomy expand, the safety risks they face also become more diverse. Existing evaluations often rely on manually written scenarios, static prompts, or final-output judgments, making it difficult to capture the diverse risks that agents may face during task execution. translated_title: ForesightSafety-SAGE：一个面向大语言模型智能体的全自动化场景生成与安全评估框架
translated_abstract: 大语言模型正日益从简单的文本交互系统演变为能够维持记忆、使用工具、访问外部环境并执行任务的LLM智能体。随着其能力和自主性的扩展，它们所面临的安全风险也变得更加多样化。现有的评估通常依赖于人工编写的场景、静态提示词或最终输出判断，难以捕捉智能体在任务执行过程中可能面临的多样化风险。我们提出了ForesightSafety-SAGE，一个面向LLM智能体的全自动化场景生成与安全评估框架。基于五个风险维度，我们将现实世界任务执行中抽象而多样的安全风险实例化为1,072个可测量的评估场景。利用该自动化评估流水线，在两种权限上下文下对12个LLM智能体进行了评估。结果表明，当前智能体仍然面临显著的行为安全风险。
tldr: 提出了ForesightSafety-SAGE框架，实现LLM智能体安全场景的全自动化生成与评估，基于五个风险维度构建1,072个可测量评估场景，并对12个智能体的评估揭示其仍面临显著的行为安全风险。
en_tdlr: ForesightSafety-SAGE is a fully automated scenario generation and safety evaluation framework for LLM agents that instantiates diverse safety risks across five risk dimensions into 1,072 measurable evaluation scenarios, with evaluations of 12 agents revealing that current agents still face substantial behavioral safety risks.
